claim_text: For people following vegan diets, a reliable B12 source from fortified foods or supplements is important; existing supplement dose, frequency, adherence and fortified-food intake should be checked before suggesting an additional product.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported supplementation and support context-specific evidence interpretation.

population.other_context: Vegan users already taking B12 products.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food sources and relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS B12 fact sheet describes fortified foods and supplements as reliable B12 sources for people whose diets exclude animal foods.
limitations: Supplement use does not prove adequate status; absorption and adherence matter.
Underlying evidence and exact source passages require full appraisal before approval.
